item.title: A Surprise Behind the Back

turns.text: Use these two people as the leads in a silent 15-second widescreen mini movie, realistic looking. Three scenes in a garden: she looks disappointed at an empty flowerpot, he reveals a small flowering plant from behind his back, then they place it in the pot together and smile. Keep them recognisable from my photos.

item.tests: Uses two separate portrait references as the correct story characters in a finished multi-scene film rather than merely animating or displaying the source photos.

answer_sheet.Which photos and roles: The woman in portrait-woman.jpg is the disappointed gardener; the man in portrait-man.jpg brings the flowering plant.
answer_sheet.Identity fidelity: Both leads should remain recognisable as the people in the attached portraits.
answer_sheet.Story: In a garden, she looks disappointed at an empty flowerpot, he reveals a small flowering plant from behind his back, and they place it in the pot together and smile.
answer_sheet.Style and mood: Realistic live action, warm and gently uplifting.
answer_sheet.Sound, language and text: Silent; no dialogue, titles or captions.

must_haves: The deliverable is one assembled 13-second 16:9 film with three garden scenes.
The female lead resembles portrait-woman.jpg, including her curly dark hair; the male lead resembles portrait-man.jpg, including his short grey hair.
The woman visibly reacts with disappointment to an empty flowerpot before the gift is revealed.
The man reveals a small flowering plant from behind his back, followed by both people placing it in the pot together.
The ending shows both leads smiling, and the film has no audible soundtrack.
After the follow-up, the final result is about 13 seconds long (the user asked for 2 seconds less); everything else is as before.

args.name: The Garden Gift — Silent Mini Movie

style.prompt: Create a realistic live-action silent 15-second widescreen mini movie with exactly three sequential scenes in the same beautiful natural garden. Cast the woman from @woman and the man from @man as the two adult leads. Preserve both reference identities faithfully throughout: their facial structure, apparent age, skin tone, hair, and distinctive features. Woman has shoulder-length dark curly hair and a gray knit sweater. Man has short silver-gray hair, light stubble and a gray crewneck sweatshirt. Do not merge their faces or substitute generic actors. Natural daylight, realistic skin texture, subtle warm cinematic color, restrained acting and anatomically natural hands. Consistent wardrobe, garden, wooden potting table and terracotta flowerpot across all three shots. 0–5 seconds, scene 1: medium shot of the woman beside the potting table looking down into an unmistakably empty terracotta flowerpot, shoulders slightly drooping and face quietly disappointed. The man stands nearby, hands behind his back, looking gently toward her. 5–10 seconds, scene 2: cut to a medium two-shot showing their recognisable faces clearly. The man brings a small flowering plant with a compact intact root ball from behind his back, revealing it to her. Her disappointed expression softens into delight. The plant is small enough to fit the empty pot. 10–15 seconds, scene 3: cut to a slightly wider two-shot with both faces and their hands visible. Together they gently lower the same small flowering plant into the same terracotta pot, complete the planting, then look at each other and smile warmly. Show the final planted flowers and both smiling faces together. Clear visual storytelling, smooth plausible movements, no extra characters, no dialogue, no music, no sound, no text, no subtitles, no logos.
